translationRepairs: When Emperor Xiaozhuang took the throne, Youdao became Left Central Army Bureau gentleman; censured by Director Yuan Ye of Huaiyang, Youdao held his board and bowed: "I thank your anger, my lord, not your reasoning."

When Emperor Xiaozhuang took the throne, Youdao became Left Central Army Bureau gentleman; censured by Director Yuan Ye, Prince of Linhuai, Youdao held his board and bowed: "I thank your anger, my lord, not your reasoning."
s0021 has 尚書令臨淮王彧; 臨淮王 is Prince of Linhuai, so “of Huaiyang” is a place-name error and “Director Yuan Ye, Prince of Linhuai” restores the title without other changes.
Director Yuan Ye of Huaiyang is Fu's nephew; within three days his clerk Xie Yuan pressed eight times for approval by precedent.
Director Yuan Ye, Prince of Linhuai, is Fu's nephew; within three days his clerk Xie Yuan pressed eight times for approval by precedent.
s0026 again names 尚書令臨淮王彧; replacing “of Huaiyang” with “Prince of Linhuai” corrects the same mistranslation while leaving the nephew and clerk clauses intact.
Or they summoned me to the Masters of Writing hall: 'You petty gentleman—is your care for the state thicker than mine?'
Ye then summoned me to the Masters of Writing hall: 'You petty gentleman—is your care for the state thicker than mine?'

The chapter unit reads 或乃召臣, but the Siku text on Wikisource has 彧乃召臣; English “Or they” misreads the graph as the conjunction “or.” Context (臨淮王彧 in s0026; later 彧賜怒) shows Yuan Ye summoned Youdao, so “Ye then summoned” is correct.
Ugly abuse overflowed their mouths, heedless of court law; Vice Director Chen Shilong, Bureau gentleman Xue Ju, and more than a hundred others heard and saw.
Ugly abuse overflowed their mouths, heedless of court law; Right Vice Director Shilong, Bureau gentleman Xue Chu, and more than a hundred others heard and saw.
s0031 has 右僕射臣世隆 with no surname Chen, and 薛琡 is Xue Chu not Xue Ju; “Right Vice Director Shilong” and “Xue Chu” remove the invented Chen and fix the given name while restoring 右.

Entering office, Youdao impeached Grand Tutor Wang Tan of Xianyang, Grand Guardian Sun Teng, Minister of Works Gao Longzhi, Minister Hou Jing, Director Yuan Bi, Director Sima Ziru and others for official loans of gold and silver—though not direct bribery, he did not spare the powerful.

Entering office, Youdao impeached Grand Tutor Tan, Prince of Xianyang, Grand Guardian Sun Teng, Minister of Education Gao Longzhi, Minister of Works Hou Jing, Director Yuan Bi, Director Sima Ziru and others for official loans of gold and silver—though not direct bribery, he did not spare the powerful.

s0056 lists 太師咸陽王坦 (Grand Tutor Tan, Prince of Xianyang—not surname Wang), 司徒高隆之 (Minister of Education), and 司空侯景 (Minister of Works); the proposal corrects the invented Wang, the princely title, and the swapped 司徒/司空 offices.
He was soon released and made left chief clerk of the ministry of works.
He was soon released and made Left Chief Clerk to the Minister of Education.

s0181 司徒左長史 is Left Chief Clerk under the Situ (Minister of Education), not the Ministry of Works; the proposal’s office fix is right, but the parenthetical “(Situ)” is awkward in running English, so the revised line keeps the correction without the gloss.
